summary: The original medium provider Crosswalk Analyst bypass is closed in the inspected correction. Native tool dispatch now exposes only the strict node-only trusted projection tool, and the service requires a projection for stored Crosswalk Analyst runs during creation, preview and application, including legacy proposals. No remaining finding was identified in this narrow follow-up.
